Do not publish that line. Job 90399 does not exist on either controller.

I queried both: on east the controller returns HTTP 404 for /api/v2/jobs/90399/, and on west it returns the same. There is no record of that job id on either one, so nothing about it failing can be verified -- and I am not going to describe an outcome for a job I could not find.

The write-up says job 90399 failed during the ocp4-cluster provision, and that claim is not supported by anything on these controllers. What the write-up should say instead depends on which job actually ran; the nearby ids on east are 90398, which succeeded, and 90400, which did fail an ocp4-cluster provision. If 90399 in the draft is a transcription slip for 90400, that is the job to cite -- but I would confirm that against the sandbox's own GUID before changing the number, rather than assume it.

Either way: remove the reference to 90399 before this goes out.
